metadata.title: Tour Operator ERP Platform Deployment Channels
metadata.description: Product bricks are deployed to the tenant back-office and tour-builder web apps, operator-branded customer websites, traveler, supplier/DMC, reseller and guide portals, partner-delivered mobile apps, the partner REST API and integration connectors (accounting, payments, flights, channel feeds, marketing, telephony, BI), and the internal tenant-administration back office. Each deployed brick records the products that use it.

channels.description: Browser-based workspaces for operator staff, travelers, suppliers, resellers and guides, one sub-channel per major web application.

The tenant's browser-based ERP workspace (1TIS GRIP, TravelSpirit BackOffice): product, CRM, booking, operations, finance, quality, workflow and reporting screens for reservations agents, operations managers and finance staff.
